goal:
Create a single self-contained index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913) with zero external dependencies and valid JavaScript syntax.

Requirements:
1. Responsive full-window <canvas id="canvas"> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling (100vw x 100vh, overflow: hidden, background: #060913).
2. Central glowing star at canvas center using createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse.
3. At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, colors, at least 3 moons/satellites orbiting planets, and fading orbital trails.
4. Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars.
5. Interactive glassmorphism HUD overlay positioned in a corner (e.g. top-left, not covering canvas center) with:
   - Play/Pause toggle button (#play-pause-btn, text "Pause" when running, "Play" when paused). When paused, pause all animation (planets, moons, corona, particles, twinkling) so the canvas is static.
   - Trails toggle button (#trails-btn, text "Trails: ON" / "Trails: OFF").
   - Reset button (#reset-btn, resets simulation time to "0.0s", clears burst particles so #particle-count is "0", clears trails, resets planet angles).
   - Speed range slider (<input type="range" id="speed-slider" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">) with live multiplier readout (#speed-value, e.g. "1.0x").
   - Live readouts: FPS (#fps, integer), simulation time (#sim-time, e.g. "0.0s"), and active burst particle count (#particle-count, integer).
6. Clicking anywhere on #canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out, updating #particle-count.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html with zero external dependencies and valid HTML5/JS syntax.
Full-viewport #canvas (#060913 background, 100vw x 100vh, overflow: hidden) using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
Central glowing star drawn with createRadialGradient and a subtle animated corona pulse.
At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, and colors.
Fading orbital trails rendered behind orbiting planets when trails are enabled.
Twinkling background starfield containing at least 150 stars.
Glassmorphism HUD overlay positioned in a corner with backdrop-filter blur.
HUD includes #play-pause-btn that toggles between Pause and Play and pauses all canvas animation when paused.
HUD includes #trails-btn that toggles between Trails: ON and Trails: OFF.
HUD includes #reset-btn that resets simulation time, clears burst particles and trails, and resets planet angles.
HUD includes #speed-slider (min 0.2, max 3.0, step 0.1, value 1.0) and #speed-value multiplier readout.
HUD displays live integer FPS in #fps.
HUD displays live simulation time in seconds in #sim-time (e.g. 1.2s).
HUD displays active burst particle count in #particle-count.
Clicking #canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
